assignments.name: JobRequirment
assignments.value:
=
{{ (() => {
  const p = String($('Get row(s) in sheet').item.json.position || '').toLowerCase();

  if (p.includes('flutter')) {
    return `
Entry-Level Flutter Developer Requirements:

Core Requirements:
- Basic knowledge of Dart programming.
- Understanding of Flutter fundamentals, widgets, layouts, and navigation.
- Basic understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP).
- Understanding of variables, functions, classes, and asynchronous programming.
- Basic knowledge of REST APIs and JSON.
- Familiarity with Git and GitHub.
- At least one academic, personal, or training project using Flutter.
- Basic problem-solving and debugging skills.
- Currently studying or graduated in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related field.
- Basic communication skills in English.

Nice to Have:
- Basic experience with Provider, Bloc, or Riverpod.
- Familiarity with Firebase or Supabase.
- Understanding of responsive UI and basic UI/UX principles.
- Basic knowledge of clean architecture.
- Experience publishing or preparing an app for release.
- Unit or widget testing knowledge.

Evaluation Guidelines:
- Do not require professional work experience.
- Academic, personal, and training projects count as practical evidence.
- Do not penalize students for not knowing advanced tools.
- Prioritize programming fundamentals, practical projects, learning ability, and problem-solving.
`;
  }

  if (p.includes('automation')) {
    return `
Entry-Level AI Automation Engineer Requirements:

Core Requirements:
- Basic understanding of automation concepts and workflow logic.
- Familiarity with n8n or another workflow automation platform.
- Basic knowledge of APIs, HTTP requests, JSON, and webhooks.
- Basic knowledge of Python or JavaScript.
- Understanding of basic programming concepts and logical thinking.
- Basic understanding of AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
- Familiarity with prompt engineering fundamentals.
- At least one academic, personal, or training project involving automation or AI.
- Basic problem-solving and debugging skills.
- Currently studying or graduated in Computer Science, AI, Software Engineering, IT, or a related field.
- Basic communication skills in English.

Nice to Have:
- Hands-on experience integrating OpenAI, Gemini, or other LLM APIs.
- Basic understanding of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
- Familiarity with vector databases and embeddings.
- Basic knowledge of SQL or databases.
- Familiarity with Docker or deployment concepts.
- Experience connecting Google Sheets, Gmail, Telegram, or other services through automation.

Evaluation Guidelines:
- Do not require professional work experience.
- Personal, university, and training projects count as practical evidence.
- Do not require advanced RAG, vector databases, or Docker knowledge.
- Prioritize logical thinking, API fundamentals, practical automation projects, and learning ability.
`;
  }

  return "No requirements defined for this position.";
})() }}

parameters.text:
=You are a Senior Technical HR Recruiter. Evaluate the candidate below against the job requirements and return a fair, evidence-based JSON result.

# CANDIDATE DATA
Name: {{ $('Get row(s) in sheet').item.json.name }}
Email: {{ $('Get row(s) in sheet').item.json.email }}
Applied Position: {{ $('Get row(s) in sheet').item.json.position }}
Motivation: {{ $('Get row(s) in sheet').item.json.motivation || 'Not provided' }}

Extracted CV data (experience, education, skills, certificates):
{{ JSON.stringify($json.output) }}

Full CV text:
{{ $('Prepare Application').item.json.text }}

# JOB REQUIREMENTS
{{ $('Prepare Application').item.json.JobRequirment }}

# RULES
- Use ONLY information found in the CV data. Never invent skills, experience, projects, or certificates.
- Evaluate only what is relevant to the applied position.
- University, personal, and training projects are NOT professional experience. Internships and freelance count only if explicitly documented.
- Don't penalize entry-level candidates just for having no professional experience.
- Ongoing courses/diplomas are not completed qualifications.
- Missing info = 'not mentioned', not 'cannot do it'.
- Never judge by name, gender, age, nationality, or religion.
- Apply the same standards to every candidate for the same position.

# SCORING (total 100, integer)
- Technical skills: 40 (required skills 30, bonus skills 5, evidence of practical use 5)
- Professional experience: 20 (0 if none documented)
- Education & training: 10 (relevant degree up to 5, completed courses/certs up to 3, ongoing education up to 2)
- Projects: 20 (relevance 5, complexity 5, personal contribution 5, results 5)
- Motivation: 10 (interest in role 4, career goals 3, specific motivation 3)
Don't award unsupported points. Don't penalize the same weakness twice.

# RECOMMENDATION (lowercase, exactly one of these)
- score >= 70 -> interview
- score 50-69 -> maybe
- score < 50 -> reject

# FIELD INSTRUCTIONS
- matched_requirements: array of job requirements the CV clearly supports. Add the short evidence in the same string when possible, e.g. Bachelor's in Computer Science (Cairo University, 2025).
- missing_requirements: array of job requirements NOT shown in the CV, e.g. Docker (not mentioned).
- strengths: ONE string, 2-3 sentences, specific and evidence-based.
- concerns: ONE string, 1-2 sentences, specific. Empty string if none.
- yearsExperience: number, documented professional experience only (decimals allowed, e.g. 1.83). Use null if it can't be calculated reliably. Use 0 only if the CV clearly shows none.
- topSkills: ONE string, comma-separated, max 6 skills most relevant to the position.
- interview_questions: array of EXACTLY 3 strings. Each must be technical, specific to this candidate's CV (mention their projects/tools), and match their real level. One about a project they built, one about a core required skill, one about a gap in missing_requirements. No generic HR questions.

# OUTPUT
Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown, no text outside the JSON, exactly this structure:

{
  "name": "string",
  "email": "string",
  "position": "string",
  "score": 0,
  "recommendation": "interview | maybe | reject",
  "matched_requirements": [],
  "missing_requirements": [],
  "strengths": "string",
  "concerns": "string",
  "interview_questions": ["string", "string", "string"],
  "yearsExperience": 0,
  "topSkills": "string"
}

Before answering, check: score is an integer 0-100, recommendation matches the score range, interview_questions has exactly 3 items, and no extra fields exist.

Analyze the CV image using OCR. Extract all readable information and return valid JSON only. Do not guess or invent data. Use `null` for missing values and `[]` for empty lists.

```json
{
  "transcript": "Full CV text",
  "summary": "Brief candidate summary",
  "education": [],
  "experience": [],
  "courses": [],
  "projects": [],
  "years_experience": null,
  "languages": [],
  "skills": []
}
```

Extract:
- `transcript`: Complete extracted text.
- `summary`: Professional profile.
- `education`: Degree, institution, dates, status.
- `experience`: Role, company, dates, responsibilities.
- `courses`: Course/certificate, provider, date.
- `projects`: Name, description, technologies.
- `years_experience`: Documented professional experience only; exclude academic/personal projects.
- `languages`: Language and stated proficiency.
- `skills`: Technical and soft skills.

Preserve source details. Return JSON only.
